scope: Scratch Identity/Directory/Patient/Appointment databases and real Gateway; mail explicitly disabled only in cloned Identity, no live account changes, no SQL state overrides; identity review inputs are synthetic workflow fixtures, not physical eKYC acceptance

checks.name: A one-time code and matching self-declared profile cannot grant access before confirmed identity
Synthetic in-person workflow requires separate reviewer and all review attestations; no real document/provider or physical verification claimed
Confirmed-match proposal still grants no ownership until the correct owner consents; other account cannot approve
Explicit owner consent grants exactly the intended profile and replay is stable; other account remains denied
Consumed authorization token cannot link a second profile
Revocation removes profile and pre-existing appointment access immediately, preserves administrative record/history and replays safely
